features.text: ADVANCED CONTRACTURE THERAPY: Treats moderate to severe wrist, hand, and finger contractures with static or dynamic stretch.
HEAT-MOLDABLE THERMOPLASTIC INSERT: Provides customizable shaping for personalized therapy.
RIGID FINGER PLATFORM: Maintains natural alignment to prevent ulnar or radial deviation.
COLOR-CODED STRAPS: Simplifies application for caregivers or clinical environments.
FLEXIBLE WRIST COMPONENT: Allows safe movement during spastic episodes while maintaining proper positioning.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Radial or ulnar deviation of the hand
